THE VISION, IN FOCUS

Leadership begins
with understanding.

The office has constitutional responsibilities. The opportunity is to fulfil them with purpose, thoughtful coordination and meaningful value for students and the Association.

“I am not seeking to change the office. I am seeking to maximise its impact.”
Explore each part of the vision as a presentation chapter. The moderator can open any chapter directly from the navigation above, move forward and backward through its slides, or return to this overview.
FROM IDEAS TO ACTION

A plan to move
with purpose.

Implementation will be collaborative, guided by the Constitution, available resources and the needs of the Association.

FIRST 30 DAYS

Listen & organise

Engage class representatives and students, conduct an initial Preclinical Pulse, identify priorities and establish coordination.

FIRST 60 DAYS

Begin priority programmes

Initiate the 100L System Buddy and begin feasible academic, skills-development and sensitisation engagements.

FIRST 90 DAYS

Review & improve

Assess progress, gather feedback, identify challenges and make practical adjustments.

THROUGHOUT THE TENURE

Communicate & sustain

Maintain documentation, collaboration, monitoring, accessibility and continuity.
